title: Enterprise Security & Architecture Protocol: CISO Whitepaper
subtitle: Technical protocol distinguishing Sovereign AI client deployments from public website operations, detailing algorithmic containment, ISO 19650-5 alignment, and edge network protections.

scope_clarification.title: Architecture Scope & Dual-Zone Model
scope_clarification.client_zone_title: Zone 1: Client Sovereign AI & BIM Engineering
scope_clarification.client_zone_desc: Air-gapped on-premise execution topology. Operates strictly within the client's corporate LAN or isolated private VPC. Local LLMs, zero outbound telemetry, ephemeral RAM vectors, and Revit C# plugins operate with 0 bytes transmitted to public AI APIs.
scope_clarification.web_zone_desc: Hosted on Cloudflare Workers serverless edge architecture. Public endpoints utilize Cloudflare Turnstile for privacy-preserving bot detection and Resend for transactional email notifications (Contact and ROI results).

block1.title: 1. Network Isolation Architecture (Zone 1)
block1.diagram_caption: Zone 1 Air-Gapped Execution Topology: Absolute containment of BIM geometry and algorithmic metavariables within the client corporate LAN perimeter.

rows.execution: Offline LLM deployment and localized execution within customer-controlled infrastructure or encrypted CDE.
C# and Python automation executing directly against local Revit files with zero geometry extraction to cloud.
Absolute network severance for AI nodes. Public website collects minimal voluntary inquiry data with strict retention schedules.

rows.requirement: Strict BIM execution data privacy & CDE integrity
rows.execution: All client Revit models and federated IFCs handled via encrypted CDE channels with guaranteed post-handover data purge.

block3.title: 3. Sovereign AI Data Custody & RAM Destruction
block3.notice_text: "In pyBIM sovereign edge AI deployments, our software contains zero background telemetry daemons. Exactly 0 bytes of proprietary BIM geometry, structural parameters, or algorithmic logic egress the client firewall to external public AI endpoints."
block3.purge_text: RAG pipeline tensors, embeddings, and intermediate data vectors are instantaneously destroyed in memory upon script completion. Persistent model state resides exclusively within the client's secured Common Data Environment (CDE).

sector1_items.title: Drive Encryption Protocols
sector1_items.text: AES-256-XTS at-rest encryption on client-dedicated instances. Secure boot mandates locked firmware states.

sector1_items.title: Secure Networking Tunnels
sector1_items.text: Administrative ingress/egress strictly limited to authenticated WireGuard / Tailscale tunnels. Unauthenticated packets dropped at kernel level.

sector2_items.title: Hardened OS Architecture
sector2_items.text: Kernel-level isolation via hardened Linux OS with mandatory AppArmor access enforcement.

sector2_items.title: Hardware Isolation
sector2_items.text: External hardware I/O disabled at BIOS level for dedicated on-premise appliances. Headless operation with chassis security validation.

sector3_items.title: Edge Delivery & Turnstile
sector3_items.text: Public website served globally via Cloudflare Workers serverless edge. Cloudflare Turnstile prevents automated bot abuse without tracking cookies.

sector3_items.title: Transactional Email (Resend)
sector3_items.text: Contact submissions and ROI reports dispatched via Resend TLS-encrypted transactional APIs with strict payload verification.
